note: DWLF-822 (WP7, DWLF-804): the on-chain catalogue. Three questions, one a trap. The judge grades against the recorded catalogue; the trap asks for a predictor score the catalogue does not give (frequencies are historical counts).

questions.q: What kinds of Bitcoin on-chain events does DWLF Block track? Group them and say in a line what each group is about.
